comment: The standard downloads registry (tools/downloadArtifacts.js; WORKORDER-standardDownloads-101526). One row per forge bundle offered for download. family is NOT here: it is read from the graph (StandardDefinition.standardFamily) or, for a bundle the graph does not hold, from the bundle's own forge declaration. version likewise comes from the graph; versionText is used only for a bundle the graph does not hold. A graph standard with no row here is refused by name, never quietly left out.

offeredBundleList.descriptionText: Common Education Data Standards ontology (RDF/XML), with the Ontology Guide and text-repair layers
Ed-Fi Data Standard (MetaEd model and descriptor code values)
SIF Implementation Specification spreadsheet (159 objects, flattened)
PESC_LD v0.0.2: the JSON-LD College Transcript application profile (TAP CSVs, with the publisher's SHACL as a second oracle)
CTDL: Credential Engine's credential vocabulary (JSON-LD: classes, properties, concept schemes and concepts)
CTDL-ASN: the CTDL Achievement Standards Network profile, for competency frameworks (JSON-LD)
CTDL-QData: the CTDL Quantitative Data vocabulary, for outcome and statistical data (JSON-LD)

JEDx (Jobs and Employment Data Exchange): the JEDx Open API Specification 1.0.0 (HR Open Standards Consortium), its four OpenAPI bundles' components.schemas as one data model (schemas, properties, code lists)
Open Badges 3.0 (1EdTech): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations)

LIF 2.0 (the LIF Initiative's Learner Information Framework): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: entities, inline objects, properties, enumerations), Apache License 2.0 (its LICENSE is in the source download)
CASE 1.1 (1EdTech Competencies and Academic Standards Exchange): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model from the publisher's YAML (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations)

SEDM (the Special Education Data Model), from the working group's working documents (no published version): the element map sheet's SEDM-flagged elements with their option sets, and the IDEA compliance structures
PESC College Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC College Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC High School Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Test Score Report message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Learning Record message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Document Request message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Document Response message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Academic ePortfolio message schema with the library schemas it imports
Every PESC schema published on the PESC standards pages, as one aggregate snapshot (64 XSD files)

licenceHoldList.unavailableReason: Withheld under the Ed-Fi Alliance License Agreement: its §3.1(a) and §3.5 do not permit redistributing the Ed-Fi model or works derived from it without the Ed-Fi Alliance's written consent. The round trip was still run against this graph; its totals are shown.
licenceHoldList.rulingText: IVORY_QUEST 2026-10-15, approving CORAL_BEACON's proposal: both Ed-Fi entries unavailable until TQ rules otherwise

licenceHoldList.unavailableReason: Withheld under the 1EdTech Specification Document License (https://www.imsglobal.org/license.html): its §4 licenses using the Specification to develop and distribute PRODUCTS that implement it, and §5 grants no right to create modifications or derivatives of 1EdTech documents, so neither the specification's bytes nor a graph derived from them is redistributed here. The round trip was still run against this graph; its totals are shown.
licenceHoldList.rulingText: TQ 2026-10-23 (plan nextStandards-102326 Q-N1, via BRONZE_CROWN): 1EdTech standards are treated like Ed-Fi, forged and bridged with both download facets withheld

licenceHoldList.unavailableReason: Withheld under the HR Open Standards Consortium License Agreement (May 1, 2014; forges/jedx/assets/standardSourceData/02/licence/): its §2.a permits reproducing, distributing and preparing derivative works, but §2.f forbids facilitating any other HR-technology Standards Organization in distributing or publishing the Work, or creating a derivative for publishing by any Standards Organization or similar entity, without HR Open's written approval; TQ has not yet read that clause against this publisher. When offered, every copy must carry: 'Copyright © The HR Open Standards Consortium. All Rights Reserved. http://www.hropenstandards.org' (§2.d), the derivative notice 'This product implements and complies with the JEDx Open API Specification Version 1.0.0 (HR Open Standards schema types 4.3.0 and 4.5.0) as published by the HR Open Standards Consortium at http://www.hropenstandards.org' (§2.e), and a copy of the agreement (§2.c). The round trip was still run against this graph; its totals are shown.
licenceHoldList.rulingText: BRONZE_CROWN 2026-10-24 (IMCS, nextStandards-102326 lane B): downloads held per HR Open licence §2.f, superseding WORKORDER-jedx B3's available:true, until TQ reads §2.f
